stories.title: Greensboro woman arrested for stabbing two students at Grimsley High School
stories.summary: Police and administrators are investigating a stabbing at Grimsley High School involving multiple students and an adult.

stories.title: Weather Impact: Getting warmer daily, then watching a rain chance this weekend
stories.summary: A coastal low could form by Sunday and send some rain across parts of North Carolina

stories.title: What's in your favorite lipstick? Consumer Reports tests 24 brands for heavy metals
stories.summary: The lowest lead levels came from a $6 E.L.F. lipstick.

stories.title: NC Attorney General Jeff Jackson sues Mt. Airy carport business for allegedly costing customers nearly $150K
stories.summary: North Carolina AG Jeff Jackson sues T-N-T Carports, alleging the company defrauded customers by not delivering paid-for metal structures. Damages total $148K.

stories.title: Virginia Foxx files for candidacy in 2028 race for NC's 5th Congressional District amid recount request
stories.summary: Virginia Foxx has officially filed for candidacy in the 2028 race for North Carolina's 5th Congressional District. This comes amid her request for a full recount.

stories.title: Two people in custody after police chase ends in High Point, police says
stories.summary: Police are investigating after a chase involving multiple jurisdictions ended in High Point.

stories.title: Don't tip twice? This Greensboro restaurant says your third visit could cost you 20% more
stories.summary: A Greensboro pub's tipping policy is drawing online attention. Owners say it's designed to protect employees, while some regulars support the change.

stories.title: Woman accused of school mass violence threat pleads guilty to lesser charge
stories.summary: Heather Brooke Clarke pleaded guilty to misdemeanor communicating threats in Rockingham County, but she now faces a new assault charge.

stories.title: Watch the Burlington Christmas Parade live on WFMY+
stories.summary: WFMY News 2 will stream the Burlington Christmas Parade on Saturday, Nov. 21 at 10 a.m.

stories.title: SBI arrests two men in email scam that cost North Carolina hospital over $196,000
stories.summary: Two men from Georgia and New York have been charged with defrauding a North Carolina hospital of nearly $200,000 through an email scam.

stories.title: It's illegal for a merchant to charge a fee on a debit card. But there's an exception...
stories.summary: You expect a fee to run a credit card, but a debit card?

stories.title: Country Park dog park to close for maintenance in Greensboro
stories.summary: The Country Park dog park is expected to reopen after maintenance is completed on Friday.
